title: shipped SlidePainter and markdown support for app descriptions
summary: the markdown feature uses an llm to format text. had to patch it because it started hallucinating creative new names for user apps. it is now strictly forbidden from renaming things

highlights.title: SlidePainter
highlights.text: Generate illustrated slide decks and export to PDF with this new community app.

highlights.title: Pixel Art & Markdown
highlights.text: A cozy new retro theme is available, plus app descriptions are now auto-formatted via the [Text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: UI Theme Cycling
highlights.text: Click the [pollinations.ai](https://hello.pollinations.ai) logo to instantly cycle through visual themes.
